title: deck.spec.json — ppt-spec-compiler declarative slide spec
description: The ONE artifact the agent hand-writes. scripts/validate_spec.py mirrors this schema with stdlib checks; scripts/compile_deck.py compiles it to .pptx. Constraint violations above meta-level caps (max_bullets, slide_limit) are compiler-managed demotions/overflows, not schema errors; absurd sizes (>15 bullets, >40 slides) are schema errors.

title.description: deck title (paper title or talk title)

slide_limit.description: max slides in the timed talk; overflow is moved to a labelled backup section at compile time

max_bullets.description: max bullets per slide; surplus bullets are demoted to speaker notes at compile time

footer_prefix.description: prefix of the stamped evidence footer, e.g. 'Source: ' or '来源：'

claim.description: exactly ONE sentence stating the slide's claim; required on content/figure/table/two-column/conclusion slides

title.description: display title; defaults to the claim; long titles are wrapped (2 lines) then elided at compile time

bullets.description: short speakable phrases; numbers/units copied verbatim from the paper

evidence.description: locators into the paper; REQUIRED and non-empty on content/figure/table slides; stamped as the slide footer

quote.description: optional short verbatim quote backing the claim; never paraphrased

path.description: PNG path relative to the spec file (absolute allowed); inserted aspect-preserved

rows.description: rows beyond 8 are compacted into notes at compile time

notes.description: speaker notes: transitions, emphasis, Q&A backup; must NOT merely repeat the bullets
